curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a man chosen solely for his terrible fortune stumble his way into solving an international disappearance?
curatedMovie.description: After his accident-prone daughter vanishes in South America, a businessman sends his most unlucky employee to retrace her steps as an unlikely detective, tailed by seasoned operative Campana to track every blunder.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lighthearted and briskly paced, offering an easygoing adventure laced with farcical mishaps.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Francis Veber spins pure comic momentum out of misadventure, pairing crime-mystery energy with the escalating absurdity of weaponized bad luck.
